kind: CPU proof of one Gated DeltaNet head (128x128 state, T=4, F=12) on the wide product oracle composed with the RNG/LKP approximate range check; synthetic inputs, no weights, no GPU

hardware.cpu: AMD EPYC-Rome, 16 vCPU (shared, loaded VM); runs pinned to 6 cores (taskset -c 0-5)

proof_parameters: research test settings inherited from #19: Goldilocks, target 10 bits, 6 work bits on QUERY, deterministic ToyCoins(100); log-length 21, log-n 22, stages {1,1,21,21},{0,0,21,21}; RNG: lanes 1, digits 12+11 bits (2D = 2^23), 16 columns, 8,192 cell rows, N = 10 combinations

fixed_point.range_cells: S', M, delta_lo, delta_hi: RNG proves |x| < 2^23 (honest |x| < 2^18)
